dialogs.about: 잠이 안 오는 밤, 할아버지과 대화

lines.en: Are you asleep? I can't sleep tonight.
lines.ko: 자요? 오늘 밤은 잠이 안 와요.

lines.en: No, I'm up. What is wrong?
My mind is not calm. I keep thinking.
lines.ko: 마음이 차분하지 않아요. 계속 생각이 나요.

lines.en: Did you drink coffee after dinner?
Yes, one cup after dinner. Maybe that's why.
lines.ko: 네, 저녁 먹고 한 잔요. 아마 그래서인가 봐요.

lines.en: Let's relax. Breathe slowly. The night is quiet.
lines.ko: 편히 쉬어요. 천천히 숨 쉬어요. 밤이 조용해요.

lines.en: Will you hold my hand?
Sure. Close your eyes. You will dream soon.
lines.ko: 물론이죠. 눈 감아요. 곧 꿈을 꿀 거예요.

lines.en: Thank you. I feel peaceful now.
Good night. Have a deep, soft sleep.

dialogs.about: 딸에게 편히 쉬는 법 조언 듣기

lines.en: I'm so tired these days. How do you relax?
Mom, I take a warm bath at night.
lines.ko: 엄마, 저는 밤에 따뜻한 목욕을 해요.

lines.en: A bath? That sounds peaceful.
It is. After that, I read in a quiet room.
lines.ko: 맞아요. 그다음 조용한 방에서 책을 읽어요.

lines.en: Last night I stayed up late.
That's why, Mom. Try soft music tonight.
lines.ko: 그래서 그래요, 엄마. 오늘 밤엔 부드러운 음악을 들어 봐요.

lines.en: Will soft music help me sleep?
Yes. You will feel calm and fall asleep.
Thank you. I will try it tonight.
Sleep well, Mom. Sweet dreams.
lines.ko: 잘 자요, 엄마. 좋은 꿈 꿔요.
